title: Dose Adjustment for Body Surface Area

content.equation:
BSA = 0.007184 * Height0.725 * Weight0.425
Adjusted_Dose = Standard_Dose * BSA / 1.73
notes: In this calculator, mcg is the abbreviation for micrograms.
The default unit of measure for weight is kilograms. Please verify that the correct unit of measure has been selected.
This calculator uses the DuBois method to determine BSA.
Dose adjustment for BSA is not appropriate for all medications or patients.
content.data_input_disclaimer: ONLY DIGITS 0 TO 9 AND A SINGLE DECIMAL POINT (".") ARE ACCEPTABLE AS NUMERIC INPUTS. ATTEMPTED INPUT OF OTHER CHARACTERS INTO A NUMERIC FIELD MAY LEAD TO AN INCORRECT RESULT.

references.text: Gerald, MC, O'Bannon. In: Nursing pharmacology and therapeutics 2nd ed. Englewood Cliffs, NJ:
Dubois D, Dubois EF. A formula to estimate the approximate surface area if height and weight be known. Arch Intern Med. 1916; 17:863-871.
